name: azure-free
description: Unofficial, guided path for creators to host a web app and a database on Azure's free tiers: sign-up, CLI setup, deploy, connect, watch costs, and clean up, with a guard that pauses any az command that would create a paid resource. Defaults to the always-free Azure SQL Database offer for apps that store data.

cost_guard.title: Cost guard mode
cost_guard.description: What to do when an az command would create or switch to a paid tier: ask (pause and ask you), block (refuse and explain), warn (only tell Claude), off.
